name: OSB/3
delivered_state: boards as sold, unfinished, standard thickness
constituents: wood strands (incl. moisture); pMDI binder; paraffin wax and other additives
constituent_sources: median of Egger EPD-EGG-20240403-IBD2-EN, Kronospan EPD-KRO-20230157-CBA1-EN, Sonae Arauco EPD-SON-20220209-ICC3-EN (https://cdn.byggtjeneste.no/nobb/5d36f435-3690-467d-bea3-7316879f18da ; https://medias.groupe-samse.fr/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire_892469.pdf ; https://www.sonaearauco.com/media/huhpryfz/epd_osb_oriented-strand-board_val2027.pdf)
manufacturing_steps: debarking; stranding; drying strands; screening; blending with resin and wax; forming/orienting; continuous hot pressing; trimming and cutting; cooling; stacking/conditioning; packaging

name: Hempcrete (hemp-lime)
constituents: hemp shives (incl. moisture); lime binder (hydraulic lime with hardener)
manufacturing_steps: batch mixing with binder and water; pressing in a concrete-block moulding machine; air drying

name: Cork board (expanded / agglomerated)
constituent_sources: EPD Hub HUB-0281 Amorim Expanded Insulation Corkboard, raw material composition 100 % bio-based (https://clfbritishcolumbia.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Novel-Expanded-Insulation-Corkboard.pdf)
manufacturing_steps: grinding into granules; autoclave expansion/agglomeration with superheated steam; cooling with recycled water and stabilisation; cutting to thickness; packing
